orderTracking.speaker: Customer
orderTracking.text: Can you tell me where my order ORD-101 is?

orderTracking.speaker: Aria
orderTracking.text: Your order ORD-101 for Priya Sharma is Out for Delivery via BlueDart and is expected by 6 PM today.

returnPolicyEnforcement.speaker: Customer
returnPolicyEnforcement.text: I bought this 20 days ago and have opened it. Can I return it?

returnPolicyEnforcement.speaker: Aria
returnPolicyEnforcement.text: I am sorry, but our return policy only accepts returns within 7 days of delivery for unopened, unused products in original packaging.

cancellationRequest.speaker: Customer
cancellationRequest.text: Can I cancel my order ORD-103?

cancellationRequest.speaker: Aria
cancellationRequest.text: Your order ORD-103 is currently in Processing and has been marked for cancellation.

outOfScope.speaker: Customer
outOfScope.text: Can you book me a flight to Goa?

outOfScope.speaker: Aria
outOfScope.text: I can only help with Aura Skincare orders, shipping, and product return policies.

damagedItem.speaker: Aria
damagedItem.text: Please report damaged products within 48 hours of delivery with photos for a free replacement.
